lines.beaver: 도립 병원 허가 건은 어떻게 됐어요?
lines.beaver_en: What happened with the provincial hospital permit?
lines.beaver_roman: dorip byeongwon heoga geoneun eotteoke dwaesseoyo?
lines.learner: 이번 회의는 형식에 그쳤어요. 결정이 없었어요.
lines.en: This meeting was just a formality. Nothing was decided.
lines.roman: ibeon hoeuineun hyeongsige geuchyeosseoyo. gyeoljeongi eopseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What does the committee member in charge say?
lines.en: The members only said there are too many regulations.

lines.beaver_en: People suggested cutting regulations long ago.
lines.en: Right. But the policy is still the same.
High-ranking officials keep putting off the decision.

lines.beaver_en: Should we ask the higher authority?
lines.learner: 네, 하지만 답은 원칙 설명에 그칠 거예요.
lines.en: Sure, but their answer will just restate the rules.
lines.roman: ne, hajiman dabeun wonchik seolmyeonge geuchil geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: The public school application is similar, right?
lines.learner: 네, 공립 학교 지원도 약속에 그쳤어요.
lines.en: Yes, support for public schools stayed a mere promise.
lines.roman: ne, gongnip hakgyo jiwondo yaksoge geuchyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Citizens' complaints are at a peak these days.
lines.en: Public office is meant to serve citizens. It's a shame.

lines.beaver: 공공기관 문제에 대해 더 말해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about the problems in public agencies?
lines.beaver_roman: gonggonggigwan munjee daehae deo malhae jullaeyo?
lines.en: Many people only want to keep their own positions.

lines.beaver: 의견이 한쪽에 치우친 것 같지는 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: Don't you think your view is a bit one-sided?
lines.beaver_roman: uigyeoni hanjjoge chiuchin geot gatjineun anayo?
lines.learner: 그럴 수도 있지만, 진상은 알아야 해요.
lines.en: Maybe, but we need to know the truth.
lines.roman: geureol sudo itjiman, jinsangeun araya haeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 다음 회의에서 같이 말해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. Let's raise it together at the next meeting.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. daeum hoeuieseo gachi malhae bwayo.
lines.learner: 네, 이번에는 말에 그치지 않게 할게요.
lines.en: Yes, this time it won't end at just talk.
lines.roman: ne, ibeoneneun mare geuchiji anke halgeyo.
